title: macOS finance and trading desktop caches/logs
scope: Finance/trading DESKTOP app caches and logs under $HOME only. Never wallets, seeds, private keys, keystores, account databases, or brokerage document trees. Crypto companions: cache/logs only (Exodus/Electrum logs only; Ledger Live / Trezor Suite Chromium caches only).
safety_notes: NEVER delete wallet roots, seed phrases, keystores, wallet.dat, SECO, or full Application Support trees for Exodus, Electrum, Ledger, Trezor, Atomic, BlueWallet, Wasabi, Monero, Bitcoin Core.
Exodus and Electrum: logs only (explicit user requirement).
Ledger Live / Ledger Wallet: Cache / Code Cache / GPUCache / logs only; leave app.json and device/account state.
Trezor Suite: Chromium cache subdirs under @trezor/suite-desktop only.
Interactive Brokers ~/Jts and ~/IBJts hold settings (tws.xml) plus logs: use include_globs for log/api files only; never wipe whole Jts.
thinkorswim ~/.thinkorswim and install trees hold workspace state: clean logs/cache/usergui update caches carefully; risk medium; default off for broad roots.
MetaTrader Wine prefixes: Logs and bar Cache only; never wipe entire bottle (EAs, templates, profiles, accounts).
MoneyMoney / Banktivity / Quicken / GnuCash: container or App Support often hold account data; target Library/Caches and Logs only.
Mint is web/mobile only (no durable Mac desktop). YNAB/Monarch primarily web; paths are best-effort Electron if present.
Bloomberg Terminal is not a native Mac product; paths are speculative leftovers only.
Robinhood has no first-party Mac desktop; only incidental webview/Electron leftovers if any.
risk medium for anything near secrets; medium/high default_enabled false.
Close trading apps before clean; never wipe while sessions are open.
sources: Homebrew cask zap: tradingview, thinkorswim, ibkr, binance, tastytrade, webull, ledger-wallet, trezor-suite, electrum, moneymoney, banktivity, quicken, gnucash
MetaQuotes MT5 Mac install docs: net.metaquotes.wine.metatrader5 and MetaTrader 5/Bottles paths
IBKR TWS API support: C:\Jts or IBJts on Mac/Linux; log.[day].txt and api.*.log
Ledger support/community: ~/Library/Application Support/Ledger Live and Ledger Wallet
Exodus docs: ~/Library/Application Support/Exodus (wallet root — logs only here)
Electrum cask: ~/.electrum (wallet root — logs only here)
notes: path_count is sum of explicit path strings in rules[].paths (182).
Electron pattern: clean Cache, Code Cache, GPUCache, Dawn*, blob_storage, Crashpad, logs; leave Local Storage, IndexedDB, Cookies, Preferences, Session Storage.
Maps to pack apps-finance via merge_macos_batches.py batch key 17-finance.

rules.name: TradingView Desktop Electron caches and logs
rules.description: TradingView Desktop Chromium caches, GPU/Dawn caches, Crashpad, and logs. Chart layouts stay in non-cache profile state.
rules.notes: Brew zap root is Application Support/TradingView; only sub-caches cleaned. Settings > Service > Clear cache is the in-app equivalent.

rules.name: thinkorswim logs and update/cache trees
rules.description: Schwab thinkorswim Java client logs and regenerable update caches. Not full workspace or login state.
rules.notes: Install often lands at ~/thinkorswim (not /Applications). usergui is regenerable update payload cache. Do not wipe whole ~/.thinkorswim (prefs/workspace). Medium: near session state.

rules.name: Interactive Brokers TWS/Gateway logs under Jts
rules.description: TWS and IB Gateway day logs and API message logs under default Mac settings dirs. Not tws.xml or full settings trees.
rules.notes: Official Mac/Linux default is IBJts; modern installers also use ~/Jts (brew ibkr zap). Logs may be encrypted. Never delete whole Jts (layouts, settings).

rules.name: IBKR Desktop app support caches and logs
rules.description: Newer IBKR Desktop (NTWS) Application Support Chromium-style caches and logs.
rules.notes: Do not wipe whole Application Support/IBKR Desktop (session/layout state).

rules.name: MetaTrader 5 Wine logs and chart bar caches
rules.description: MT5 Mac Wine-prefix platform Logs and regenerable Bases cache bars. Not bottle root, MQL5 EAs, profiles, or templates.
rules.notes: Official data dir: Application Support/net.metaquotes.wine.metatrader5/.... Never delete whole wine prefix (EAs, indicators, templates, account state).

rules.name: MetaTrader 4 Wine logs
rules.description: MT4 Mac Wine-prefix Logs only (legacy platform).
rules.notes: Parallel layout to MT5. Leave experts, indicators, templates, history.

rules.name: cTrader Mac desktop caches and logs
rules.description: cTrader native Mac / Spotware desktop Chromium or app caches and logs.
rules.notes: cTrader Mac is relatively new (native); path names may vary by broker-branded builds. Leave workspace/cBot sources.

rules.name: Bloomberg desktop leftovers (rare on Mac)
rules.description: Speculative Bloomberg Terminal/Anywhere cache or log leftovers if a Mac bridge/client was installed.
rules.notes: Bloomberg Terminal is primarily Windows. Report-only: avoid deleting license/SSO state if present.

rules.name: Yahoo Finance Mac app container caches
rules.description: App Store / container caches for Yahoo Finance if installed; not web browser history.
rules.notes: Yahoo Finance is mostly mobile/web; Mac paths are best-effort bundle ids.

rules.name: Robinhood incidental webview/Electron leftovers
rules.description: No first-party Mac desktop; clean only incidental Electron/webview cache folders if present.
rules.notes: Robinhood is web/mobile. Paths are speculative; leave any Local Storage (session tokens).

rules.name: Coinbase desktop Electron caches and logs
rules.description: Coinbase exchange/desktop Electron Chromium caches and logs only. Not wallet key material.
rules.notes: Never wipe whole Coinbase/Coinbase Wallet Application Support (may hold encrypted vault metadata).

rules.name: Binance desktop Electron caches and logs
rules.description: Binance Electron desktop caches and dedicated Logs tree (brew zap confirms roots).
rules.notes: Leave Local Storage/IndexedDB (login/session). Medium near exchange credentials.

rules.name: Kraken Pro / desktop caches and logs
rules.description: Kraken Pro desktop Electron caches if installed.
rules.notes: Kraken desktop availability varies; paths are Electron-standard best effort.

rules.name: Exodus wallet logs only
rules.description: Exodus desktop log files only. Never wallet SECO/seed/key material under Application Support/Exodus.
rules.notes: HARD RULE: logs only. Do not target Application Support/Exodus root (holds SECO wallet). Do not clean Cache next to wallet files without expert review.

rules.name: Electrum wallet logs only
rules.description: Electrum log directory only under ~/.electrum. Never wallets/ or seed material.
rules.notes: HARD RULE: logs only. ~/.electrum holds wallets/*. Never wipe ~/.electrum root (brew zap is uninstall-only).

rules.name: Ledger Live / Ledger Wallet Electron caches
rules.description: Ledger Live (renamed Ledger Wallet) Chromium Cache/Code Cache/GPUCache/logs only. Not device data or app.json.
rules.notes: Seeds live on hardware device, not here, but app state still sensitive. Never delete app.json, Local Storage, or whole Application Support root.

rules.name: Trezor Suite desktop Chromium caches
rules.description: Trezor Suite Electron caches under @trezor/suite-desktop. Not remembered-wallet state.
rules.notes: Community-confirmed Cache path. Leave IndexedDB/Local Storage (remembered wallets labels). Seeds on device.

rules.name: Quicken Mac caches and HTTP storage
rules.description: Quicken regenerable caches under Library/Caches and App Support cache subtrees. Not Quicken data files.
rules.notes: Do not wipe whole Application Support/Quicken (may hold local data indexes). User documents often under Documents (never-touch).

rules.name: MoneyMoney caches only
rules.description: MoneyMoney App Store/sandbox caches. Not Containers account database.
rules.notes: Brew zap lists Containers/MoneyMoney; never wipe whole container (bank accounts).

rules.name: Banktivity container caches
rules.description: Banktivity sandboxed Library/Caches only. Not document packages.
rules.notes: Banktivity documents are user .bank8 files (often Documents). Cache only.

rules.name: GnuCash cache and logs
rules.description: GnuCash Application Support cache/log subtrees. Not GNC book files.
rules.notes: Cache/logs only. Never Application Support/Gnucash books or user .gnucash files (often Documents, never-touch).

rules.name: YNAB / Monarch / Mint desktop leftovers
rules.description: Best-effort Electron or container caches for budget apps. Mint has no durable Mac desktop.
rules.notes: YNAB Classic Mac is retired; modern YNAB/Monarch are web-first. Mint discontinued personal product. Paths are opportunistic.

rules.name: Excel finance add-in and WEF-related caches
rules.description: Excel stock connector / Office JS add-in web caches related to finance add-ins. Complements office pack WEF rules.
rules.notes: WEF wipe clears sideloaded add-ins. Close Excel first. Not workbook files.

rules.name: tastytrade and Webull Desktop caches
rules.description: Additional US broker desktop Electron/Java caches common on Mac traders' machines.
rules.notes: Brew zap roots: Application Support/tastytrade and Webull Desktop. Cache subdirs only.

rules.name: Other wallet app log trees (report-only)
rules.description: Logs-only inventory for secondary wallet apps. Never wallet data roots.
rules.notes: Report-only. Atomic/Wasabi/BlueWallet/Monero hold secrets in sibling dirs; do not expand to roots.
